summary: Backend-only iter14 validation for new POST /api/auth/setup-complete endpoint + setup_completed user flag. All 6 new iter14 tests PASS: admin POST flips flag → response & /auth/me both show setup_completed=true; fresh guest defaults to setup_completed=false; flag persists across logout+re-login; unauthenticated requests return 401; old token after logout is rejected. Regression suite (iter11 + iter12 + iter13 = 20 tests) all PASS — smart_reply EN/HI counts, paraphrase EN/HI translation suffix, TTS nova/coral voices, guest device persistence + race protection unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/auth/setup-complete endpoint is correctly auth-gated via get_current_user (401 on missing/bad token) and idempotent (re-calling does not break).

_user_public() at /app/backend/server.py:260 always emits setup_completed (defaults to false via bool() coercion), so existing users without the field show false until they POST setup-complete — correct behaviour.
seed_data_creation: Created a transient guest user with device_id TEST_DEVICE_ITER14_FRESH_<rand> and cleaned it up in the module-scoped mongo fixture teardown. Admin user setup_completed flag is left as true after the run (account-bound flag is intentional and idempotent).

Admin user himthegreat@gmail.com now has setup_completed=true in DB.
